Livestock Management

Industry Trends

RFID technology: What funding is available?

LIVE STREAM THURSDAY, AUGUST 13 AT 1 PM CT - How does RFID technology works, who is eligible for funding and why stronger traceability matters to the future of the U.S. swine industry?

August 7, 2026

RFID technology helps strengthen traceability by making it easier to identify pigs, improve movement records and respond more quickly during a disease outbreak. Funding is available to help pig farmers receive RFID 840 tags, while fairs and exhibition sites and sow harvesting facilities can apply for funding for handheld readers and reader panels. Together, these tools help everyone involved in pig movement strengthen traceability and support a more resilient U.S. swine herd. Joining us to discuss how RFID technology works, who is eligible for funding and why stronger traceability matters to the future of the U.S. swine industry is Brent Pepin, DVM, MS, director of swine health for National Pork Board, and Mark Wright, The Parks Company.

translationZh:
RFID技术通过简化猪只识别、改进移动记录以及在疾病暴发时加快响应速度，有助于加强可追溯性。目前已有资金支持养猪户获得RFID 840耳标，同时展览会和母猪屠宰设施也可以申请资金购买手持读取器和读取器面板。这些工具共同帮助所有参与猪只移动的相关方加强可追溯性，并支持美国猪群更具韧性。

与我们一同讨论RFID技术如何运作、谁有资格获得资金以及为什么更强的可追溯性对美国养猪业的未来至关重要的嘉宾是：国家猪肉委员会猪健康主任Brent Pepin（DVM, MS）和The Parks Company的Mark Wright。
